title: Utility (Generic) product catalogue, version 1
sourceDescription: Selected product evidence from current vendor pages, checked on 21 November 2026. Claims state what the vendor describes, not proven suitability for an organisation. Editorial review is pending. Coverage spans the sector’s main capability areas but is not exhaustive; a missing product is not evidence that no product exists.

entries.summary: Network information management and analysis software for utilities.

capabilities.name: Asset Register & Data
capabilities.howItSupports: Models network assets and their connectivity

claims.statement: The vendor describes ArcGIS Utility Network as network information management and analysis software for utilities.
